newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends firmer, strong weekly sales cited.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends firmer, strong weekly sales cited.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed firmer for the second straight session as talk of robust new sales in the last week inspired fresh buying, market sources said.
"Of course, the report is going to be bullish tomorrow but the market may not go up since it has already absorbed the sales," he said, referring to Friday's export and sales report.
USDA will issue the weekly report at 0830 EST.
The benchmark March contract climbed to a high of 75.10 cents a lb but retreated to close at 74.65 cents, up 0.55 cent. Deferreds finished unchanged to 0.33 cent firmer.
Volume was estimated at 15,000 lots versus Wednesday's official tally of 16,066 lots.
The market also awaited Friday's monthly consumption report.
